title: Candle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Candle body -->
  <rect x='35' y='45' width='30' height='45' rx='4' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <!-- Candle top rim -->
  <rect x='33' y='42' width='34' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FFD699'/>
  <!-- Candle bottom -->
  <rect x='33' y='86' width='34' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD699'/>
  <!-- Candle body highlight -->
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='6' height='35' rx='3' fill='#FFF0D4'/>
  <!-- Wax drips -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='47' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <!-- Wick -->
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <!-- Flame outer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#FFA500'/>
  <!-- Flame inner -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Flame core -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  <!-- Flame glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFE4B5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Face - eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='62' r='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='61' r='1' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='61' r='1' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 71 Q50 78 57 71' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='68' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='68' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
